name: Random Number Field
description: Adds a random number field type which populates the field with a random number based on the min/max values given.
project_description: Random Number Field adds a field type of 'Random Number (integer)' that populates an entity with a random integer, drawn from a configurable min/max range, when new content is created. It extends core's integer field, widget and formatter and adds only the random-default behaviour, so it behaves like an ordinary integer field once saved. It is intended for non-cryptographic purposes such as raffle numbers, sampling weights, non-sequential display identifiers or test data.
